messages:
Maya K: Quick sync — follow-up from last week's high-latency incident (us-west). Need to lock owners, timelines, and decide whether to adjust SLOs or alerts.
Carlos G: +1. I dug into traces this morning, looks like a connector throttling spike + queue buildup during a burst.
Anika S: Can we get the error-budget burn numbers? I want to see whether this was a one-off or recurring pattern.
slo-bot: Incident summary: 2035128720 latency spike. 10m peak, 95th latency breach to 750ms (SLO=500ms). Error budget consumed: 0.6% for the week.
Maya K: Thanks @slo-bot. So we didn't exceed the monthly error budget but weekly burn is high. Proposals: 1) assign remediation owner for connector throttling (Carlos), 2) add a dashboard tile for queue depth and tail latency, 3) tighten alert to 99th if we think 95th is too noisy, 4) consider SLO recalibration if pattern repeats. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Lee: I can own dashboard work. I'll add queue depth, consumer lag, and 99/95/50p latencies. ETA: EOD Tues.
Carlos G: I'll take connector remediation. Initial root cause: upstream rate-limiter backoff + our retry policy amplifying bursts. Plan: tune retry jitter, add backpressure signals, and add a circuit-breaker. Target: PR in 2 weeks, deploy in 3.
Priya: From an SLA/customer perspective we need to be careful changing SLO numbers. If we propose recalibration, product should own comms. I can coordinate.
Anika S: Pattern check: I scanned past 90 days — 4 similar small spikes across us-west and eu-west during deploy windows. So not strictly one-off.
Maya K: Good catch. That pushes us toward more proactive safeguards vs just alert tuning. Action items:
- Carlos: connector retry/jitter + circuit-breaker (timeline above)
- Lee: dashboard tiles (EOD Tues) + dashboard alert suggestions
- Priya: SLA communications plan and approval path (sync by Fri)
- Anika: run 90-day recurrence analysis and add to postmortem doc (due Thu)
- Maya: review SLO thresholds with product & SRE (proposal meeting next Wed)

Carlos G: Noted. Will add a short RFC in #eng-platform with before/after load test numbers.
Lee: Dashboard link (draft): https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ux123/latency-overview — I'll add the new tiles and share.
Anika S: For recurrence analysis, I'll include deploy timestamps and correlate with autoscaler activity. If deploy windows coincide, we may need deployment throttles.
Maya K: Also propose a short-term mitigation: disable aggressive retries during peak deploy windows. Can we make that a feature flag?
Carlos G: Yes, can gate retry policy via env flag and default to safer settings during deploys. Quick change, can ship in 3 days if prioritized.
Priya: I sketched a short message for customers if this affects SLA: "We detected intermittent latency increases affecting some requests during deployment windows. We're implementing deployment safeguards and tuning retries — no SLA credits expected at this time." I'll refine once we decide.
Maya K: Great. Let's capture these as follow-ups in the postmortem action tracker. Also assign owners in the SLO board so we can track burn vs action completion.
ops-bot: Created task: SLO-625 "Connector retry remediation" assigned to Carlos G, due 2035132400.
Maya K: One more decision point: do we move alerting to alert on 99th p99 > 1s for 5m rather than 95th? That would reduce noise but may delay detection of user-facing regressions.
Anika S: I prefer keeping 95th for detection but add a p99 alert for escalation. So two tiers: 95th for SRE paging, p99 for priority paging.
Lee: Implementation note for dashboards: add an SLO burn widget showing rolling 7d and 30d % consumption, with a threshold highlight at 75%.
Carlos G: I'll also add a smoke test before deploys to ensure connector latencies stay below the SLO envelope.
Maya K: OK summary: owners and timelines assigned, Lee for dashboards, Carlos for remediation, Anika for analysis, Priya for comms, Maya to coordinate SLO review. Meet next Wed 10am to decide whether to recalibrate SLOs or keep them and add mitigations.
Priya: Added to calendar invite.
Maya K: Thanks team. Please update the postmortem thread with PR links and dashboard snapshots as you go. :thumbsup:
Carlos G: Will do — starting on RFC now.
Lee: Dashboards incoming.
Anika S: Analysis will land by Thu.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up meeting 2035133600.
